director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ground ki boundary se perimeter, yaani charon taraf ki lambai, dekhenge. Tum cricket dekhti ho?
Achha, cricket se shuru karte hain, Riya. Ground ke charon taraf rope lagani ho, toh rope ki lambai jaanne ke liye kya naapogi?
Riya, ground ke chaaron taraf rope lagegi, toh har side ki lambai jodni hogi. Isi total ko perimeter, yaani parimap, kehte hain. Kya-kya jodogi?
Riya, tumne 4 kaha—rectangle ki chaar sides hoti hain. Rani ke park ki length 50 m, breadth 30 m hai; ek round kaise nikalogi?
Riya, ek round park ka perimeter hai: 50 aur 30 ko jodkar double karo, toh 160 m. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Riya, tumhara jawab saaf nahi pakad paayi. Ek baar phir bolo: 160 m ke teen rounds ki kul lambai kitni m hogi?
Riya, tumne 6 likha, par teen rounds ki lambai nikalni hai. Ek round ki 160 m lambai ko teen baar jodne se shuru karo. Khaali jagah bharo: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
Pichhle sawaal ka jawab 480 m hai, kyunki 160 m ke teen rounds utne hote hain. Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm hain. Iska perimeter kya hai?
director.card: Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm hain. Iska perimeter kya hai?

director.text: Riya, tumne 8 likha. Perimeter ke liye teeno sides jodte hain. 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm wali sides ka total kya hoga?
director.card: Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm hain. Iska perimeter kya hai?

director.text: Riya, tum abhi rukna chahti ho, theek hai. Aage chalna hai, chhota break lena hai, ya aaj ke liye band karein?
